The '''2020–21 Linafoot''' was the 60th season of the [[Linafoot]], the top-tier [[association football|football]] league in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], since its establishment in 1958. The season started on 2 October 2020 and ended on 9 June 2021<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesz/zaire2021.html Congo-Kinshasa (DR Congo) 2020/21], rsssf.org</ref> Defending champions [[TP Mazembe]] won their 3rd consecutive and 19th overall Linafoot title.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://footrdc.com/classement-linafoot-vodacom-ligue-1-2020-2021/|title=Classement Linafoot Vodacom Ligue 1 (2020-2021)|accessdate=10 July 2021|website=footrdc.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eventsrdc.com/rdc-foot-le-tp-mazembe-sacre-champion-de-la-26e-edition-de-la-vodacom-ligue-1-officiel/|title=RDC – Foot : Le TP Mazembe sacré champion de la 26e édition de la Vodacom Ligue 1 (Officiel)|trans-title=DRC - Foot: TP Mazembe crowned champion of the 26th edition of the Vodacom Ligue 1 (Official)|accessdate=10 July 2021|website=eventsrdc.com}}</ref>

==Teams changes==
16 teams compete in this season: the top 14 teams from the previous season and two promoted teams from the [[Linafoot Ligue 2|2019–20 Linafoot Ligue 2]].
